reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 001365 (the melody read from 001365a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. W. Harrison has no death year on CCEH's page or ours; their work is dated 1621, before 1850, so they died before 1955 (they would have been over 105). Thomas Ravenscroft has no death year on CCEH's page or ours; their work is dated 1621, before 1850, so they died before 1955 (they would have been over 105).
